title: Exterior derivative along an affine coordinate cube equals the divergence of its coefficient field
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, ι : Fin (m+1) → Fin P arbitrary, a ∈ Euclid P, and let γ : Euclid P → Covector(Euclid P, m) be a C¹ m-form. Put Φ(y) := a + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} (y ∈ Euclid (m+1)), E := (e_{ι(j)})_{j∈Fin(m+1)}, and for i ∈ Fin (m+1), F_i(y) := (−1)^i γ(Φ(y))(e_{ι(succAbove i l)})_{l∈Fin m}. Then every F_i is C¹, and for every y ∈ Euclid (m+1): dγ(Φ(y))(E) = Σ_i DF_i(y)(e_i), where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 and d is SimonGMT's exteriorDerivative.
